title: Big mobs
description: This data pack will make all mobs in the game larger, and you will be half as big.
body: This data pack will make all mobs in the game larger, and you will be half as big. Additionally, mobs will have some stats increased due to their size, while you will have some stats decreased due to your small size. Mobs will also trample you now. If you walk near a mob, it may trample you to death.
